name: Rope Trick

header.Components: V, S, M (a segment of rope)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch rope; create extradimensional entrance and space for eight Medium-or-smaller creatures; rope up/down, window vision, climbing access and combat/spell barrier; end safely releases occupants and contents.

rules.text: One end of it hovers upward until the rope hangs perpendicular to the ground or the rope reaches a ceiling.
At the rope’s upper end, an Invisible 3-foot-by-5-foot portal opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends.
That space can be reached by climbing the rope, which can be pulled into or dropped out of it.
The space can hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures.
Attacks, spells, and other effects can’t pass into or out of the space, but creatures inside it can see through the portal.
Anything inside the space drops out when the spell ends.
